method.provider: plain isolated /bin/sh; no native provider, sidecar or service manager
method.controller: production RuntimeConnections and RuntimeReconciler in the test process; excludes daemon startup
method.cpu: cumulative ps CPU-time delta; percentage of one CPU core
method.cpu_precision: Reported display-resolution margin allows one displayed CPU-time tick per owner; it is not a confidence interval and excludes asynchronous snapshot skew
method.reaped_child_cpu: ps -S adds exited children, including terminal-monitor ps probes; excludes live children at sample boundaries and all controller/daemon CPU
method.rss: resident size summed across processes; shared pages may be counted repeatedly
method.descriptors: numeric open descriptors; excludes cwd, executable and mapped-library pseudoentries
method.native: macOS installed-SDK proc_pid_rusage, calibrated against CPU clock/getrusage; exact PID start identities and per-read elapsed bounds; raw decimal counters retained
method.native_controller: test process including Vitest, controller and measurement orchestration; self only, excludes reaped measurement tools; not isolated daemon overhead
method.native_children: owner reaped-child counters exclude live children; shell self counters reported separately; these do not establish a complete process-tree total
method.native_wakeups: interrupt and package-idle wakeup counters only; not total scheduler wakeups or energy consumption
